$comment: Shared by ts/tests/adapters/qwen-sessionlog.test.ts and tests/adapters/test_qwen_session_logs.py. Synthetic transcripts written from the pinned upstream source (no installed-binary capture). Files under chats/ carry the placeholder __WORKDIR__ (the project root as qwen-code records it in every ChatRecord.cwd: path.resolve(process.cwd()), i.e. the physical absolute path).

sourceQualification.membership: first record cwd must equal the project root (sanitized dirs collide)
sourceQualification.legacyLogsJson: tmp/<sha256(projectRoot)>/logs.json holds user prompt history only (no usage)

main.$comment: Two assistant records with usageMetadata (640+200 prompt, 150+0 candidates); the ui_telemetry snapshot repeats the same totals and must not be aggregated; the second assistant record is re-emitted with the same uuid (counted once); its model carries the $runtime|<auth>| prefix which is stripped.

unrelated.$comment: cwd belongs to another project that sanitizes into the same chats dir; must be rejected by discovery even when newest.

noUsage.$comment: No assistant record: usage and model are unknown, not zero.

sidecar.$comment: Live-session status sidecar next to the transcript; never a session candidate.

legacyLayout.$comment: The pre-TWA-96 helper looked for ~/.qwen/tmp/<basename(workdir)>/logs.json with a ~/.gemini fallback. Neither is a session.
